name: Maestro: Doom Bound
summary:
Face your destiny in "Doombound", an inescapable content update for Maestro! Conduct five legendary pieces, including the Main Theme from Game Of Thrones and Lord Of The Rings, and meet more doomed heroes from the classical composers.

Tracklist:

Djawadi — Main Theme (from Game Of Thrones)
Shore —The Bridge of Khazad Dum (from "The Lord Of The Rings)
Offenbach — Orpheus in the Underworld: Can Can Shostakovich — Symphony n°10
Liszt - Totentanz

Step in The Altar, where dark rituals are held, don the Shaman’s Gloves and their sacrificial Bone Needle and conduct the Barbarian Army through the darkness of this repertoire!
